package assistance_test

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/assistance"
)

type teacherEnsurerStub struct {
	teacher domain.PersonalTeacher
}

func (stub teacherEnsurerStub) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return stub.teacher, nil
}

type decisionReaderStub struct {
	repository.TeacherDecisionReader
	decisions []domain.TeacherDecision
}

func (stub decisionReaderStub) ListByLearningAction(context.Context, string, string) ([]domain.TeacherDecision, error) {
	return stub.decisions, nil
}

type closureFinalizerStub struct {
	repository.LearningActionAssistanceFinalizer
	closure    domain.LearningActionClosed
	assistance *domain.LearningActionAssistance
	event      *domain.IntegrationEvent
	processed  bool
}

func (stub *closureFinalizerStub) Finalize(
	_ context.Context,
	closure domain.LearningActionClosed,
	value *domain.LearningActionAssistance,
	event *domain.IntegrationEvent,
) (bool, error) {
	stub.closure = closure
	stub.assistance = value
	stub.event = event
	return stub.processed, nil
}

func finalizeFixture(decisions []domain.TeacherDecision) (assistance.Finalize, *closureFinalizerStub) {
	finalizer := &closureFinalizerStub{processed: true}
	return assistance.Finalize{
		Teachers: teacherEnsurerStub{teacher: domain.PersonalTeacher{
			ID:        "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
			StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		}},
		Decisions:  decisionReaderStub{decisions: decisions},
		Assistance: finalizer,
		IDs: &idStub{values: []string{
			"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
			"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		}},
		Clock: clockStub{value: time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
	}, finalizer
}

func TestFinalizeBuildsIndependentSummaryWhenTeacherStayedSilent(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, finalizer := finalizeFixture(nil)
	processed, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), validClosure())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.NotNil(t, finalizer.assistance)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherSupportIndependent, finalizer.assistance.SupportContext)
	require.Equal(t, []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{{
		Target: domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "learning.semantic-sequence"},
		Kind:   domain.TeacherObservationIndependentContext,
	}}, finalizer.assistance.Observations)
	require.NotNil(t, finalizer.event)
	require.Equal(t, domain.SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved, finalizer.event.Subject)
}

func TestFinalizeAggregatesHintAndInterventionDecisions(t *testing.T) {
	levelTwo := 2
	levelFour := 4
	decisions := []domain.TeacherDecision{
		{Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, HintLevel: &levelTwo},
		{Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, HintLevel: &levelFour},
		{Action: domain.TeacherActionIntervene},
	}
	useCase, finalizer := finalizeFixture(decisions)
	_, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), validClosure())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherSupportGuided, finalizer.assistance.SupportContext)
	require.Equal(t, 2, finalizer.assistance.HintsUsed)
	require.Equal(t, 4, *finalizer.assistance.MaxHintLevel)
	require.True(t, finalizer.assistance.InterventionUsed)
	require.Len(t, finalizer.assistance.Observations, 3)
}

func TestFinalizeRecordsInboxOnlyWhenActionHasNoTargets(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, finalizer := finalizeFixture(nil)
	closure := validClosure()
	closure.LearningTargets = nil
	processed, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), closure)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.Nil(t, finalizer.assistance)
	require.Nil(t, finalizer.event)
}

func TestFinalizeSupportsThreeObservationsForEveryFrozenTarget(t *testing.T) {
	level := 1
	useCase, finalizer := finalizeFixture([]domain.TeacherDecision{
		{Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, HintLevel: &level},
		{Action: domain.TeacherActionIntervene},
	})
	closure := validClosure()
	closure.LearningTargets = make([]domain.LearningTargetRef, 100)
	for index := range closure.LearningTargets {
		closure.LearningTargets[index] = domain.LearningTargetRef{
			Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability,
			Key:  fmt.Sprintf("capability-%03d", index),
		}
	}
	processed, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), closure)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.Len(t, finalizer.assistance.Observations, 300)
}

func validClosure() domain.LearningActionClosed {
	closure := validLearningActionClosureForUseCase()
	return closure
}

func validLearningActionClosureForUseCase() domain.LearningActionClosed {
	return domain.LearningActionClosed{
		EventID:          "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		StudentID:        "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CorrelationID:    "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		CausationID:      "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LearningActionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		ContextType:      domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:        "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{
			{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "learning.semantic-sequence"},
		},
		OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}
